config.composition: 20 semantic documents plus 980 deterministic original synthetic support records; all genuinely encoded by the same model
config.relevance: No semantic labels for the 980 controls. Their experiment evaluates numerical nearest-neighbor approximation only.
config.reference: FAISS FlatL2 over the same normalized float32 vectors; squared L2
config.insertionOrder: semantic IDs D01..D20, then S0001..S0980; single native thread; native default graph RNG, not an exposed controlled seed
config.annRecall: Intersection of ANN top10 IDs with the stored exact FlatL2 top10 / 10, mean across20 queries. Exact-boundary ties may make set recall sensitive; retain distances and boundary gaps.
config.schedule: round-major, strategies in declared order, queries Q01..Q20; no best-run selection
config.timing: performance.now around synchronous native search only, preencoded inputs, result allocation included; record every request; no end-to-end or concurrency claim
config.pgvector: Separate PostgreSQL run, exact and HNSW cosine with plans verified; pg client query timing includes IPC; never compare it as pure native kernel time
